_z.1. 只能修改上面清单中的文件，输出操作块：\n===FILE: 文件名===\:
1. Only modify files from the list above, output an operation block:
===FILE: filename===
full new file content
===END===
_z.2. 内容被标记（…内容过长已截断）的大文件，禁止用 ===FILE:=== 全:
2. For large files marked (…truncated), NEVER rewrite the whole file with ===FILE:=== (unshown parts would be lost) — use an incremental patch instead:
===PATCH: filename===
<<<<
an exact snippet from the file that needs changing
>>>>
replacement content
====
(<<<< / >>>> / ==== may repeat: text between <<<< and >>>> is the original, between >>>> and ==== is the replacement)
